Complaints? Video submissions? Sponsorships? Collabs? Business inquires?

event_summary.short: A Dodge Charger Hellcat driver, Omar Garcia, fleeing police at over 100 mph, crashed head-on into another vehicle, killing two adults and injuring a 1-year-old child. Garcia was arrested, charged, and later pleaded guilty to multiple charges including vehicular homicide and DUI.

evidence.quote: On the night of September 7, 2004, Rome police in Georgia clocked a Black Dodge charger speeding
the driver of the charger, later identified as Omar Garcia
The victims were identified as 23-year-old Kadrian Harris and 23-year-old Malik Henderson

Garcia was arrested at the scene and charged with two counts of vehicular homicide, one count of serious injury by vehicle, DUI, driving without a license, fleeing and attempting to elude, reckless driving, and driving too fast for conditions.
Ultimately, Garcia pleaded guilty and was sentenced to 20 years in prison.
